national_news.title: Finance Minister Highlights India's Economic Strength and Fiscal Prudence at Kautilya Economic Conclave
bullets: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman spoke at the 5th Kautilya Economic Conclave in New Delhi, emphasizing fiscal prudence, banking reforms, and infrastructure investment.
Highlighted a 7.8 percent real GDP growth in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026-27 and noted IMF projections of India's general government debt declining from 83.4% in 2026 to 77.7% in 2031.
Stated that capital expenditure for the fiscal was budgeted at ₹12.22 lakh crore, alongside significant expansions in national highways and operational airports since 2014.

national_news.title: India Achieves Historical Medals at Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan
bullets: Kumkum Mohod became the first Indian woman to win an Asian Games individual recurve gold in archery, while also securing a 2028 Los Angeles Olympics quota place.
The Indian Women's Hockey team won gold after 44 years by defeating China 1-0, automatically qualifying for the LA 2028 Olympics.
Gold medals were also secured by Sujeet Kalkal (Men's 65kg Freestyle Wrestling), Lovlina Borgohain (Women's 75kg Boxing), Parveen Hooda, Ankush Panghal, and the Women's Recurve Archery team.

bihar_news.title: Changing Geography and Impact Patterns of Bihar Floods
bullets: Data from Bihar's Disaster Management Department highlights changing flood dynamics: 50.49 lakh people across 15 districts were affected in Sept 2026, compared to 48 lakh across 23 districts in 2025 and 52.46 lakh across 28 districts in 2024.
Shifting river courses, embankment breaches, and flooding along rivers like the Gandak are expanding vulnerabilities into new settlements and non-traditional risk areas.
The analysis emphasizes a transition from routine emergency response to a sustained risk reduction framework through updated vulnerability mapping and resilient infrastructure design.
